<DESCRIPTION>SHARE EXCHANGE AGREEMENT

<BODY STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">

<P STYLE="text-align: right; margin: 0">Exhibit 10.2</P>

<P STYLE="margin: 0; text-align: right">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="color: #102A43; font: bold 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 12pt 0 0; text-align: center">Share Exchange Agreement</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">This Share Exchange Agreement (this &ldquo;Agreement&rdquo;) is entered
into as of December 16, 2025 (the &ldquo;Effective Date&rdquo;), by and between Renewal Fuels, Inc., a Delaware corporation (&ldquo;RNWF&rdquo;
or the &ldquo;Company&rdquo;), and Brent Nelson, an individual and the sole controler of Kepler Fusion Technologies Inc., a Texas corporation
(&ldquo;KEPLER&rdquo; or the &ldquo;Target&rdquo;) (the &ldquo;Seller&rdquo;). RNWF and Seller may be referred to herein individually
as a &ldquo;Party&rdquo; and collectively as the &ldquo;Parties.&rdquo;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">WHEREAS, pursuant to that certain Stock Purchase Agreement dated as of
December 16, 2025 (the &ldquo;Stock Purchase Agreement&rdquo;), by and between Manufacturing 360, LLC, as seller, and Earth Sciences Fund
I LLC, as buyer, ESF acquired control of RNWF by purchasing one (1) share of RNWF&rsquo;s 2020 Series A Special Preferred Stock (the &ldquo;Control
Share&rdquo;), which carries two times the total voting power of all other outstanding securities of RNWF and therefore confers full shareholder-level
voting control;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">WHEREAS, following the consummation of the Stock Purchase Agreement pursuant
to which Earth Sciences Fund I LLC (&ldquo;ESF&rdquo;) acquired the Control Share of RNWF, the Parties intend to effect a business combination
through a share exchange under which RNWF will acquire one hundred percent (100%) of the issued and outstanding equity interests of KEPLER;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">WHEREAS, Seller owns or controls all of the issued and outstanding equity
interests of KEPLER, which he desires to exchange with RNWF for newly issued shares of RNWF capital stock (the &ldquo;Exchange Shares&rdquo;),
subject to the terms and conditions set forth herein;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">WHEREAS, concurrently with the exchange, KEPLER shall become a wholly owned
subsidiary of RNWF, and RNWF shall be the surviving publicly traded parent company of the combined enterprise (the &ldquo;Reverse Merger&rdquo;);
and</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">WHEREAS, the Parties desire to enter into this Agreement to effect the
exchange of equity interests and to set forth certain representations, warranties, covenants, and agreements with respect thereto.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">NOW, THEREFORE, in consideration of the mutual covenants and agreements
contained herein, and other good and valuable consideration, the receipt and sufficiency of which are hereby acknowledged, the Parties
agree as follows:</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="color: #102A43; font: bold 12pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 2pt; margin-bottom: 0"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 11pt"><B>1.</B></FONT></TD><TD><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATION</FONT></TD></TR></TABLE>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 11pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.3in"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">1.1.</FONT></TD><TD><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt"><U>Definitions</U>. For purposes of this Agreement, the following terms shall have the meanings set
forth below:</FONT></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0"><B>&quot;Affiliate&quot;</B> means, with respect to any Person, any other
Person that, directly or indirectly, controls, is controlled by, or is under common control with, such Person.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0"><B>&quot;Agreement&quot;</B> has the meaning set forth in the Preamble.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0"><B>&quot;Business Day&quot;</B> means any day except Saturday, Sunday or
any other day on which commercial banks located in New York, New York are authorized or required by Law to be closed for business.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0"><B>&quot;Closing&quot;</B> has the meaning set forth in Section 4.1.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0"><B>&quot;Closing Date&quot;</B> has the meaning set forth in Section 4.1.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0"><B>&quot;RNWF&quot;</B> means Renewal Fuels, Inc., a Delaware corporation.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0"><B>&ldquo;Exchange Shares&rdquo;</B> means the shares of RNWF capital stock
issued to Seller in exchange for all of Seller&rsquo;s equity interests in KEPLER pursuant to this Agreement.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0"><B>&quot;Governmental Authority&quot;</B> means any federal, state, local
or foreign government or political subdivision thereof, or any agency or instrumentality of such government or political subdivision,
or any self-regulated organization or other non-governmental regulatory authority or quasi-governmental authority (to the extent that
the rules, regulations or orders of such organization or authority have the force of Law), or any arbitrator, court or tribunal of competent
jurisdiction.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0"></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0"><B>&quot;Law&quot;</B> means any federal, state, local or foreign law,
statute, ordinance, rule, regulation, code, order, constitution, treaty, common law, judgment, decree or other requirement or rule of
law of any Governmental Authority.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0"><B>&quot;Order&quot;</B> means any order, injunction, judgment, decree,
ruling, writ, assessment or arbitration award of a Governmental Authority.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0"><B>&quot;Parties&quot;</B> Parties means RNWF and Seller, and <B>&ldquo;Party&rdquo;</B>
means either of them individually.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0"><B>&quot;Person&quot;</B> means an individual, corporation, partnership,
joint venture, limited liability company, governmental authority, unincorporated organization, trust, association or other entity.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0"><B>&ldquo;Reverse Merger&rdquo;</B> has the meaning set forth in the recitals
to this Agreement.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0"><B>&quot;Seller&quot;</B> means Brent Nelson, the sole controller of all
outstanding equity interests of KEPLER.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 11pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 13.5pt"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 26.1pt"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">1.2.</FONT></TD><TD><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt"><U>Interpretation</U>. Unless the context of this Agreement otherwise requires: (a) words of any gender
include each other gender; (b) words using the singular or plural number also include the plural or singular number, respectively; (c)
the terms &quot;hereof,&quot; &quot;herein,&quot; &quot;hereby&quot; and derivative or similar words refer to this entire Agreement; (d)
the terms &quot;Article&quot; or &quot;Section&quot; refer to the specified Article or Section of this Agreement; (e) references to &quot;including&quot;
shall mean &quot;including, without limitation;&quot; and (f) references to agreements and other documents shall be deemed to include
all subsequent amendments and other modifications thereto.</FONT></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="color: #102A43; font: bold 12pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 2pt; margin-bottom: 0"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 11pt"><B>2.</B></FONT></TD><TD><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">SHARE EXCHANGE</FONT></TD></TR></TABLE>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 12pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 2pt; margin-bottom: 0"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.3in"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 11pt; font-weight: normal">2.1.</FONT></TD><TD><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt; font-weight: normal"><U>Exchange of Kepler Equity Interests</U>. Seller hereby transfers, assigns, and
delivers to RNWF all of Seller&rsquo;s right, title, and interest in and to one hundred percent (100%) of the issued and outstanding equity
interests of KEPLER, free and clear of all Liens, and RNWF hereby accepts such equity interests in exchange for the issuance of the Exchange
Shares as set forth in this Agreement.</FONT></TD></TR></TABLE>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 12pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 2pt; margin-bottom: 0"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.3in"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 11pt; font-weight: normal">2.2.</FONT></TD><TD><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt; font-weight: normal"><U>Form of Transfer</U>. The transfer of the KEPLER equity interests shall be effected
at Closing through the delivery of all certificates, stock certificates, equity ledgers, assignments, or other instruments necessary to
transfer record and beneficial ownership of KEPLER to RNWF, and shall be reflected in the books and records of KEPLER immediately upon
Closing.</FONT></TD></TR></TABLE>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 12pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 2pt; margin-bottom: 0"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.3in"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 11pt; font-weight: normal">2.3.</FONT></TD><TD><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt; font-weight: normal"><U>No Assumed Liabilities</U>. RNWF is acquiring the Kepler Equity Interests only
and is not assuming any liabilities or obligations of Seller of any kind, whether known or unknown, fixed or contingent, unless expressly
set forth in this Agreement.</FONT></TD></TR></TABLE>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 12pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 2pt; margin-bottom: 12pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.3in"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 11pt; font-weight: normal">2.4.</FONT></TD><TD><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt; font-weight: normal"><U>As-Is Transaction</U>. RNWF acknowledges and agrees that the Kepler Equity Interests
are being transferred on an &ldquo;as-is, where-is&rdquo; basis, with all faults and without any representation or warranty of any kind,
express or implied, by Seller, except as expressly set forth in this Agreement. Buyer further acknowledges that it has conducted its own
independent investigation of KEPLER and RNWF and has not relied on any representations or warranties by Seller or any other Person, except
those expressly set forth in this Agreement.</FONT></TD></TR></TABLE>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="color: #102A43; font: bold 12pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 2pt; margin-bottom: 0"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 11pt"><B>3.</B></FONT></TD><TD><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">EXCHANGE CONSIDERATION</FONT></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-right: 0; margin-bottom: 0; margin-left: 0">As consideration for the transfer
and assignment of all issued and outstanding equity interests of Kepler Fusion Technologies Inc. (&ldquo;KEPLER&rdquo;) to Renewal Fuels,
Inc. (&ldquo;RNWF&rdquo;), and in accordance with the overall transaction structure contemplated by the Master Sales Agreement dated December
16, 2025 (the &ldquo;MSA&rdquo;), the Parties acknowledge and agree as follows:</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 12pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 2pt; margin-bottom: 0"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.3in"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 11pt; font-weight: normal">3.1.</FONT></TD><TD><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt; font-weight: normal">Effective as of the Closing, RNWF shall acquire all right, title, and interest
in and to one hundred percent (100%) of the issued and outstanding equity interests of KEPLER, free and clear of all liens, claims, and
encumbrances (except as set forth in this Agreement or the Disclosure Schedules), thereby making KEPLER a wholly owned subsidiary of RNWF.</FONT></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"></P>

<P STYLE="margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 12pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 2pt; margin-bottom: 0"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.3in"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 11pt; font-weight: normal">3.2.</FONT></TD><TD><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt; font-weight: normal"><U>Acknowledgment of Prior Change of Control</U>. The Parties acknowledge that
voting and governance control of RNWF was previously transferred pursuant to the Stock Purchase Agreement dated December 16, 2025, between
Manufacturing 360, LLC, as seller, and Earth Sciences Fund I LLC, as buyer, under which Earth Sciences Fund I LLC acquired one (1) share
of RNWF&rsquo;s 2020 Series A Special Preferred Stock (the &ldquo;Control Share&rdquo;), which carries voting rights equal to two times
the aggregate voting power of all other outstanding classes and series of RNWF and therefore confers full shareholder-level voting control.
As a result of such transaction, Earth Sciences Fund I LLC, and its designated affiliates hold majority voting control of RNWF. This Agreement
does not transfer or modify the Control Shares or the voting rights associated therewith but instead effectuates the exchange of Seller&rsquo;s
equity interests in KEPLER for newly issued shares of RNWF in accordance with the terms set forth herein.</FONT></TD></TR></TABLE>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 12pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 2pt; margin-bottom: 12pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.3in"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 11pt; font-weight: normal">3.3.</FONT></TD><TD><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt; font-weight: normal"><U>Exchange Shares</U>. The Parties acknowledge and agree that the Exchange Shares
to be issued to Seller, whether at Closing or pursuant to post-Closing capitalization actions authorized by RNWF, shall constitute the
consideration for the acquisition of KEPLER pursuant to this Agreement.</FONT></TD></TR></TABLE>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="color: #102A43; font: bold 12pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 2pt; margin-bottom: 0"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 11pt"><B>4.</B></FONT></TD><TD><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">CLOSING</FONT></TD></TR></TABLE>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 12pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 2pt; margin-bottom: 0"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.3in"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 11pt; font-weight: normal">4.1.</FONT></TD><TD><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt; font-weight: normal"><U>Closing</U>. The closing of the transactions contemplated by this Agreement
(the &ldquo;Closing&rdquo;) shall take place remotely via electronic exchange of documents and signatures on or before December 16, 2025,
or at such other time as the Parties may mutually agree in writing (the &ldquo;Closing Date&rdquo;).</FONT></TD></TR></TABLE>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 12pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 2pt; margin-bottom: 0"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.3in"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 11pt; font-weight: normal">4.2.</FONT></TD><TD><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt; font-weight: normal"><U>Deliveries by Seller</U>. At the Closing, Seller shall deliver, or cause to
be delivered, to RNWF the following:</FONT></TD></TR></TABLE>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 12pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 2pt; margin-bottom: 0"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.8in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 11pt; font-weight: normal">a)</FONT></TD><TD><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt; font-weight: normal">an executed assignment of all of Seller&rsquo;s equity interests in KEPLER, sufficient
to transfer to RNWF one hundred percent (100%) of the issued and outstanding equity interests of KEPLER, free and clear of all Liens;</FONT></TD></TR></TABLE>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 12pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 2pt; margin-bottom: 0"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.8in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 11pt; font-weight: normal">b)</FONT></TD><TD><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt; font-weight: normal">the organizational documents, corporate records, minute books, and capitalization
records of KEPLER, to the extent in Seller&rsquo;s possession or control;</FONT></TD></TR></TABLE>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 12pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 2pt; margin-bottom: 0"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.8in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 11pt; font-weight: normal">c)</FONT></TD><TD><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt; font-weight: normal">any additional transfer instruments reasonably required to effectuate the transfer
of KEPLER to RNWF as contemplated herein.</FONT></TD></TR></TABLE>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 12pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 2pt; margin-bottom: 0"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.3in"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 11pt; font-weight: normal">4.3.</FONT></TD><TD><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt; font-weight: normal"><U>Deliveries by RNWF</U>. At the Closing, RNWF shall deliver to Seller:</FONT></TD></TR></TABLE>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 12pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 2pt; margin-bottom: 0"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.8in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 11pt; font-weight: normal">a)</FONT></TD><TD><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt; font-weight: normal">evidence of RNWF&rsquo;s obligation to issue the Exchange Shares to Seller, which
shall be duly authorized and issued either at Closing or pursuant to post-Closing capitalization actions in accordance with this Agreement
and the Master Sales Agreement;</FONT></TD></TR></TABLE>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 12pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 2pt; margin-bottom: 0"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.8in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 11pt; font-weight: normal">b)</FONT></TD><TD><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt; font-weight: normal">any executed agreements or deliverables required under this Agreement or reasonably
requested by Seller to effectuate the exchange.</FONT></TD></TR></TABLE>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 12pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 2pt; margin-bottom: 0"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.3in"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 11pt; font-weight: normal">4.4.</FONT></TD><TD><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt; font-weight: normal"><U>Effect of Closing</U>. Upon consummation of the Closing:</FONT></TD></TR></TABLE>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 12pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 2pt; margin-bottom: 0"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.8in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 11pt; font-weight: normal">a)</FONT></TD><TD><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt; font-weight: normal">RNWF shall acquire all right, title, and interest in and to KEPLER, and Seller
shall become a wholly owned subsidiary of RNWF;</FONT></TD></TR></TABLE>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 12pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 2pt; margin-bottom: 0"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.8in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 11pt; font-weight: normal">b)</FONT></TD><TD><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt; font-weight: normal">Seller shall be entitled to receive the Exchange Shares in accordance with this
Agreement and the Master Sales Agreement, and upon issuance Seller shall hold such Exchange Shares with all rights appurtenant thereto.</FONT></TD></TR></TABLE>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 12pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 2pt; margin-bottom: 12pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
